# InviterLink Bot — Full Documentation

> Telegram bot for timezone-aware meeting scheduling with reminders & DMs

## Overview

InviterLink Bot is a serverless Telegram bot deployed on Vercel. It creates meeting cards with multi-timezone time conversion for 7 cities (DST-aware via `zoneinfo`), Google Calendar links, scheduled reminders at 45 and 5 minutes before the meeting (via QStash), and personal DM notifications to participants via Telethon userbot.

## Features

- Meeting card with title, date, day of week, and time across timezones
- DST-aware timezone conversion for Riga, Tel-Aviv, Rome, Istanbul, Bishkek, Beijing, Los Angeles
- Google Calendar inline button
- Dual reminders (45 min + 5 min) via Upstash QStash (up to 7 days delay)
- Personal DMs to up to 5 participants via Telethon
- Dynamic allowlist stored in Upstash Redis (with env fallback)
- Admin roles for allowlist management
- Webhook secret verification, input sanitization

## Usage Format

```
Title, DD.MM.YYYY, HH:MM, Link, @user1 @user2
```

Time input is in Istanbul timezone. If Riga and Tel-Aviv match — they merge into one line.

## Commands

- `/start` — show format help
- `/cancel` — cancel last reminder
- `/adduser <ID>` — add user to allowlist (admin only)
- `/removeuser <ID>` — remove user from allowlist (admin only)
- `/users` — show allowed users (admin only)

## Stack

- Python + Flask — HTTP server (serverless)
- pyTelegramBotAPI — Telegram Bot API wrapper
- Telethon — userbot for sending direct messages
- QStash (Upstash) — delayed reminder scheduling
- Redis (Upstash) — dynamic allowlist storage
- zoneinfo — IANA timezone database with DST support
- Vercel — deployment platform

## Architecture

Single serverless function at `api/index.py` (Flask app).

Flow: User → Telegram → Vercel webhook → Flask route → allowlist check (Redis/env) → meeting card + QStash scheduling → /reminder endpoint → DMs via Telethon.

Key functions:
- `webhook()` — main entry point, processes Telegram updates
- `create_meeting(message)` — parses input, builds card, schedules reminders
- `reminder_trigger()` — QStash callback endpoint, sends reminder + DMs
- `send_userbot_messages(usernames, text)` — Telethon async DM sender
- `is_user_allowed(user_id)` — Redis → env fallback allowlist check
- `cancel_qstash_message(msg_id)` — cancels a scheduled QStash message

## Cities & Timezones

| City | IANA Zone |
|---|---|
| Riga | Europe/Riga |
| Tel-Aviv | Asia/Tel_Aviv |
| Rome | Europe/Rome |
| Istanbul | Europe/Istanbul |
| Bishkek | Asia/Bishkek |
| Beijing | Asia/Shanghai |
| Los Angeles | America/Los_Angeles |

## Environment Variables

| Variable | Description | Required |
|---|---|---|
| BOT_TOKEN | Bot token from @BotFather | Yes |
| QSTASH_TOKEN | Upstash QStash token | Yes |
| APP_HOST | Vercel domain | Yes |
| TG_API_ID | Telegram API ID | For DMs |
| TG_API_HASH | Telegram API Hash | For DMs |
| TELETHON_SESSION | StringSession string | For DMs |
| WEBHOOK_SECRET | Telegram webhook secret | Recommended |
| REMINDER_SECRET | /reminder endpoint secret | Recommended |
| UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL | Redis REST URL | For allowlist |
| UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN | Redis REST token | For allowlist |
| ADMIN_USER_IDS | Comma-separated admin IDs | Recommended |
| ALLOWED_USER_IDS | Comma-separated user IDs (env fallback) | Optional |

## Project Structure

```
teleinv/
├── api/
│   └── index.py           # Main bot logic (527 lines)
├── generate_session.py     # Telethon StringSession generator
├── logo.png                # Bot logo
├── requirements.txt        # Python dependencies
├── vercel.json             # Vercel routing
├── .gitignore
├── llms.txt                # LLM-readable project summary
├── llms-full.txt           # LLM-readable full documentation
└── README.md
```

## Limitations

- QStash free tier: max delay 7 days (604,800 sec)
- Vercel serverless: `last_qstash_msg` state is not persisted across instances
- Telethon: avoid frequent sends to prevent account ban
